'''Fleet Command''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] with a detachable [[Fleet Command annex|annex]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. During the latter part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], when the world was the capital of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the station housed [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|New Republic Fleet Command]] and [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force Fleet Command|Galactic Alliance Fleet Command]].
